label: Bible Study
prompt: A time to be born, and a time to _____; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verse: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
note: The second verse of 'a time for everything' — the list starts at birth and works from there.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall _____:
verse: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
note: Amos's whole message in six words: Seek ye me, and ye shall live.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his _____.
verse: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
note: Jacob's final act of faith: blessing Joseph's two sons, and worshipping as he leaned on the top of his staff.

label: Deep Water
prompt: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither _____ nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
note: Right after 'baptized into Christ': ethnic, social and gender lines don't rank anyone in God's family.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy _____ out of his place, except thou repent.
verse: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
note: To Ephesus, who had left their first love: repent, or I will 'remove thy candlestick' — the church's lamp.
